technical_and_design_decisions: Kafka and RabbitMQ test JUnit rules will be decoupled into independent Git repositories/modules and published as dedicated test artifact dependencies.
SCDF Admin REST endpoints will be normalized behind standard Spring MVC controllers decoupled from cloud platform SPI implementations (Lattice, YARN, Cloud Foundry).
Stream DSL parser and deployment planner will be enhanced to support named channel destination syntax (`:channelName`) as first-class endpoints.
Library registration will store artifact coordinates in the App Registry service, extending include/exclude dependency resolution logic.
Stream name uniqueness will be enforced via persistent unique constraints in the repository layer and validation checks prior to stream definition persistence.
Spring Cloud Stream Kinesis source module will leverage AWS Java SDK v2 and Spring Integration Kinesis adapters.
assumptions: The developer has full access to repository configuration, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platform test environments.
Java 17+ and Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6 standards apply to all modified repositories.
Test fixtures extractable from Kafka and Rabbit rules do not depend on internal proprietary enterprise infrastructure.

activities.activity_name: Extract Kafka and RabbitMQ Test Rules into Separate Repositories
activities.activity_description: Extract JUnit test rules and fixtures for Kafka (U1) and RabbitMQ (U2) into standalone open-source repositories, setup build files, publish test artifacts, and update existing project dependencies.

activities.activity_name: Standardize Platform REST API Layer for Admin Server
activities.activity_description: Implement platform-agnostic REST controllers and response mappings (U3) to ensure consistent REST API behavior across Lattice, YARN, and Cloud Foundry deployers.

activities.activity_name: Implement Artifact Library Registration and Include/Exclude Resolution
activities.activity_description: Add support for registering application artifacts as reusable libraries (U4) in the artifact registry and support library references in include/exclude dependency resolution logic.

activities.activity_name: Support Named Channels in Stream DSL and Runtime Deployment Engine
activities.activity_description: Update Stream DSL parser and deployment mechanics (U5) to support named channels (`:my-channel`), allowing stream creation without explicit source or sink apps.

activities.activity_name: Add Comprehensive Build-time Test Coverage for StreamController
activities.activity_description: Write Spring MVC mock tests and contract verification tests (U6) for StreamController REST endpoints to validate API contracts during builds.

activities.activity_name: Implement Unique Stream Name Enforcement and Validation
activities.activity_description: Add database unique constraints and service validation logic (U7) to prevent stream creation with duplicate names and return proper HTTP 409/400 errors.

activities.activity_name: Develop Spring Cloud Stream AWS Kinesis Source Module
activities.activity_description: Implement the Kinesis source binder/module (U8) allowing AWS Kinesis streams to act as event sources in streaming pipelines.

activities.activity_name: End-to-End Integration Testing, Documentation, and CI Updates
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end testing across stories, update reference documentation, and verify automated build workflows.
